name: GODONLIF Candle Warmer Lamp with Timer

image.alt: Black arched candle warmer lamp with a clear textured glass shade and circular base.

cardLine: An arched candle warmer with textured glass and a timer.
description: This electric tabletop candle warmer pairs a black arched support with a clear, patterned glass shade and a timer. Its bulb warms a jar candle from above, making it an interesting piece to incorporate into a reading corner or evening console arrangement.
whyWePicked: The rounded arch and fluted glass give a candle-warming accessory a distinct place in a styled corner.
